change_note: Sérgio Pinto, 2026-08-25 13:41 WEST — froze the accepted-paper check-worthiness contract so new reproductions cannot silently change the reported task, splits, models, or values.
scope: Sérgio Pinto's claim check-worthiness experiments and associated ablations
primary_metric: binary F1 for the positive check-worthy class

paper_method.fusion: three-seed DeBERTa ensemble plus LLM features with late fusion
paper_method.final_reporting: held-out test labels are used once after selection

reproduction_invariants: Paper-reported values remain immutable historical targets.
Every cross-file join uses sentence_id or Sentence_id and validates one-to-one coverage.
Evaluation labels cannot select a threshold in a protocol-conformant result.
An evaluation-set threshold sweep is labelled as a historical or diagnostic oracle, never as a held-out reproduction.
Fresh outputs retain exact model revisions, input hashes, per-example probabilities, configuration, and full-precision metrics.
No raw Twitter/X post identifiers, user identifiers, usernames, profiles, or locations are released.

known_source_boundary.ct24_dev_test: The official English dev-test file has 318 rows, whereas the paper reports N=317. No row is removed merely to force the paper count.
known_source_boundary.historical_results: Historical values and fresh protocol-conformant replications are stored separately; a new run does not replace historical provenance.
